```{r count_charts}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)
library(scales)

top_n <- 15

# ── Chart 1: largest GovObras project types ───────────────────────────────────

type_counts <- projects_st |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(type_en)) |>
  count(type_en, name = "projects") |>
  mutate(
    share = projects / sum(projects),
    type_label = str_wrap(type_en, width = 34)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(projects)) |>
  slice_head(n = top_n)

plot_types <- ggplot(
  type_counts,
  aes(x = fct_reorder(type_label, projects), y = projects)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, fill = "#0B5FA5") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        comma(projects),
        "  ·  ",
        percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)
      )
    ),
    hjust = -0.08,
    size = 3.7,
    colour = "#1F2937"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GovObras projects by type",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top ", top_n,
      " project types, ranked by number of project records"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of projects",
    caption = "Source: GovObras. Percentages use all classified project records."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, colour = "#102A43"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "#52606D"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, colour = "#6B7280", hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.5, colour = "#243B53"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#52606D"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#E5E7EB"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 95, 15, 15)
  )

plot_types


# ── Chart 2: largest GovObras type–subtype combinations ───────────────────────

type_subtype_counts <- projects_st |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(type_en), !is.na(subtype_en)) |>
  count(type_en, subtype_en, name = "projects") |>
  mutate(
    share = projects / sum(projects),
    project_label = str_wrap(
      paste0(type_en, " — ", subtype_en),
      width = 48
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(projects)) |>
  slice_head(n = top_n)

plot_type_subtypes <- ggplot(
  type_subtype_counts,
  aes(x = fct_reorder(project_label, projects), y = projects)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, fill = "#0F766E") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        comma(projects),
        "  ·  ",
        percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)
      )
    ),
    hjust = -0.08,
    size = 3.7,
    colour = "#1F2937"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GovObras projects by type and subtype",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top ", top_n,
      " type–subtype combinations, ranked by number of project records"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of projects",
    caption = "Source: GovObras. Percentages use all classified project records."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, colour = "#102A43"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "#52606D"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, colour = "#6B7280", hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "#243B53"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#52606D"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#E5E7EB"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 100, 15, 15)
  )

plot_type_subtypes
```

```{r}
projects_st_clean <- projects_st

geometry <- st_geometry(projects_st_clean)

projects_st_clean$geometry_type <- as.character(
  st_geometry_type(geometry)
)

projects_st_clean$geometry_empty <- st_is_empty(geometry)

projects_st_clean$geometry_valid <- st_is_valid(
  geometry,
  NA_on_exception = TRUE
)

projects_st_clean$coordinate_problem <- vapply(
  geometry,
  function(g) {
    if (st_is_empty(g)) return(FALSE)
    
    box <- st_bbox(g)
    
    # The file is labelled EPSG:4674, so coordinates should be lon/lat.
    box["xmin"] < -180 ||
      box["xmax"] > 180 ||
      box["ymin"] < -90 ||
      box["ymax"] > 90
  },
  logical(1)
)

# Remove empty geometries and geometries with incompatible coordinates
projects_st_clean <- projects_st_clean |>
  filter(!geometry_empty, !coordinate_problem)

# Repair invalid geometries retained in the cleaned data
st_geometry(projects_st_clean) <- st_make_valid(
  st_geometry(projects_st_clean)
)

st_write(projects_st_clean, "projects_st_clean.gpkg")
```
